title: Electromagnetic Field Data Simulator: topological EM coupling from Faraday tensor computations
description: A high-performance topological electromagnetic coupling simulator built on Faraday tensor computations. A Rust reference core computes the Faraday tensor, Lorentz invariants, coupling fields and a topology proxy; a Python generator emits reproducible JSON datasets through a CLI; and a React application renders the fields interactively for the browser.
